messages.subject: JIRA notifications
messages.body_plain:
Hi

I am planning to add a notification rule in our JIRA installation (http://sparkr.atlassian.net/) to send an email to the dev list when any issue is updated. I think this will be useful to keep track of things right now and we can disable this going forward if it becomes too noisy.

Let me know if you have thoughts on this.

Thanks
Shivaram
